title: Cuts, blocks, rings and split bases: what is proved
claim: C1: on a complement-closed base (not-all-equal and betweenness knots of any arity; also parity where the distinction is not fixed), the bonds at a separating distinction are the two sides' and the joins (B_L u B_R) - y, so bond distance minus one adds across it and two distinctions on one side see only that side. C2: bond distance is a metric exactly when it is one on every block of the primal graph. C3: on a ring of not-all-equal-class knots, plain or twisted, b = steps apart + 1 on every pair; so every tree of knots and rings has b - 1 = steps apart. C4: on split bases b <= 2 exactly when every separated pair has a third between (lines and full grids: b = 2), a diameter statement.
standard_statement: Parallel connection of matroids (Brylawski 1971); lossless joins of acyclic schemes (Beeri-Fagin-Maier-Yannakakis 1983); block-cut trees; minimal non-shattered sets.
